preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID every day — several pantries require it or strongly recommend it
Call The Gathering at (414) 272-4122 before your first visit to confirm no appointment is needed
Call SVdP Cross Roads Kitchen at (414) 649-9555 and Harambee Kitchen at (414) 249-3866 to confirm cost and any entry requirements
Call COA Goldin Center at 414-265-7696 before Saturday to confirm hours and that they serve 53206
Call Ebenezer Stone Ministries at 414-488-8070 to confirm the pop-up is scheduled this Saturday (weather-dependent)
Call Maccanon Brown at 414-404-0600 to confirm Tuesday pantry hours and service area
At every pantry, ask specifically for no-cook, ready-to-eat items — you have no kitchen
Northside Community Pantry (res-001) has a once-per-7-days limit; plan your single visit accordingly
If any site is closed or full, call 211 (dial 2-1-1) for same-day alternatives
unmet_needs: No verified dinner on Saturday (Sep 12) — call 211 for options
No verified breakfast or lunch on Sunday (Sep 13) — pantry items from earlier days may help; call 211
No kitchen available all week — all pantry visits must yield ready-to-eat or no-cook items; confirm this before each visit
res-003 (Fresh Fixture Mobile Market) excluded — paid option, $0 budget
data.explanation: You have no kitchen and $0 budget, so the plan prioritizes free sit-down meals (no cooking needed) every day they're available, plus free pantry pickups where no-cook items may be available. All Gathering and SVdP meal sites are verified open; pantry visits are conditional — call ahead to confirm no-cook items and service area. res-003 (paid market) is excluded. Wednesday and Sunday have no verified free meals; pantry options are listed but need confirmation. Call providers before traveling.
